spells.name: Counter-current
spells.effect: Until the start of your next turn, halve run rolls and charge rolls for the target.
spells.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Idoneth Deepkin Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

spells.name: Pressure of the Deep
spells.effect: Roll a dice for each model in the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
spells.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Idoneth Deepkin Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

spells.name: Steed of Tides
spells.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.
spells.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Idoneth Deepkin Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **^^Idoneth Deepkin^^** unit wholly within 12" of them and not in combat to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
